title: Tuning check, batch 8: 16 units × 2, dropout 0.0, learning rate 0.01
description: Batch-size check of the grid's best configuration with the original A0 training (batch 8, learning-rate factor 0.7 after 10 flat epochs, early stop 25, at most 200 epochs). Reported only: the study keeps batch 64 for run time. Same data and network as the tuning run HT_u16_l2_d00_lr01; chosen by session-1 validation loss only. Training windows are fed in time order (no shuffling).

dashboard.label: Chosen network, batch 8
dashboard.name: Batch-size check: the chosen network with batch 8
dashboard.blurb: Original A0 training (batch 8, up to 200 epochs) at the learning rate tuned for batch 64 (0.01), which is too high for batch 8: not a fair test of batch 8 in general.
